utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, but those people didn't -- those two didn't work. Cvjetin and Cviko, Simic Cvjetin, yes. He worked in the kitchen. He worked in the kitchen, and the other one was a supervisor. He helped us occasionally because he knew us all.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: So they worked there, they didn't work on the separation line, but worked on some other jobs?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Zika was a craftsman. He was supervising whether we were working properly or if everything was all right. Otherwise, he was a brick layer, and I knew him personally, and he would check on how we worked.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Do you know the name of Doslic Ibro?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, he worked together with --

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Doslic Ibro?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't remember. Djordjevic Zivorad, maybe.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: I will read a few names to you which, according to my information were janitors in the separation plant, and just confirm if you knew any of them. Doslic Ibro.

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Mimica Slavko?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Markovic Sasa?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I cannot -- I do not recall.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Masuc Jova?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't recall.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Markovic Rade?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know him.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: These --

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Do you want me to tell you who worked at the gate then? He was the son of the -- his father was the secretary of party committee who liked playing chess. His son was sitting at the gate. I didn't see anybody else there.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: If you cannot remember the name, what was his nationality?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: He was a Serb. I cannot remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: So it's -- there's no doubt, it was a Serb?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, a Serb, but he was sickly, and therefore that is why he was working at the gate.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And if he weren't sickly, he would be working somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot give you a definite opinion on that.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hadzijusufovic, to the question of the Prosecutor whether you were ever paid, remunerated, for the work you performed in the work brigade through your obligation, from April to August, that you've received no remuneration?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Neither I nor my son.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Now, I will be showing you a document, but we'll just show it to you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: [In English] [Previous translation continues] ... 2E/2 ter. And this one is also under seal. It is, according to my notes, D32E/2 ter. We have the English translation, but it's under seal, I believe. Am I right, it's under seal? Your Honours, I have maximum four questions. If I may be given the opportunity to finish today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: So we can excuse the witness and --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: I'm sorry, there is a re-cross.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: But these you can finish your cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So you've looked at this document, haven't you, Mr. Hadzijusufovic?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: I'll read it out to you. The title is: "The list of workers engaged in the work brigade for the months of April, May, June, July, and August 1992." Is that it?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's what it says.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Under number 10, Ilija Arsic, do you know that man?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: By name and surname?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If I saw him perhaps.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: You would say by his name that he is a Serb?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are Serbs, and Ilija, I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Next page, number 2. Will you turn the leaf, please. Number 58. Zivorad Djordjevic, isn't it, number 58? Can you see it?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He did work.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That's the same person who worked at the separation company with you?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, but he worked there the whole time, and it says here only one day out of several months.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: On page number 3, number 92, Ilija Ivanovic, can you see it?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Do you know this man?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am sure I know all these people, but I can't remember that now. Not by name and surname. I'm sure I was in their company.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Can you tell me by their name what their ethnicity is?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a Serbian surname.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Number 84 on that page. Jusuf -- Nusret Hadzijusufovic. It says you worked there for a certain amount of days, and the total amount due is 7.200?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: You never got that amount?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's go to the next page. Page 6, the last page. The last page of this document, number 174. Dragan Vuksanovic?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Do you know him?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a Serbian surname.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Pero, also known as Pita?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course I know him. If you don't know Pita, you don't know Samac.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: All right. I apologise. Tell me, do you know that Dragan had a work obligation?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the Tekstilac company. He worked in the canteen of the Tekstilac company.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: As part of his work obligation?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know about that. I know he worked, and I think he worked in order to be able to take some food back home. They didn't dare give him a rifle.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: They didn't dare give him a rifle?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Can I say one more thing, if I may look at this list a while longer?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Please go ahead.

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It says: Esref Fitozovic here. It's a neighbour of mine. I can't understand it. He's an older man, and I never saw him on work obligation. I never saw him working. He lived on my street, Vuk Karadzic Street. He is an elderly man who didn't work.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: It may be another person altogether.

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: With the same name? If that is possible.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Look at other names.

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't want to. I know this man, but perhaps there is another man by the same name in Samac.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: You have read four or five names, including your own, on this list.

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: But I can't see my son anywhere. He worked throughout these months. Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: There are other lists as well. I gave you this one because you are on it. Please tell me, these four other names belong to Serbs in your assessment?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Arsic is a Serbian surname.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That seems to indicate that Serbs also worked in the work brigade?

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, according to this list.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Well, you said a moment ago --

utterances.speaker: NUSRET HADZIJUSUFOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I said that, for instance, Pita did work there.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That's what I asked you about. You know this man personally.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have no further questions. [In English] Mr. Usher, the document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, re-examination will be conducted tomorrow starting at 14.15 hours. We shall adjourn until tomorrow. Court will rise.
